verdict: Google spend produced zero leads; Meta is carrying everything right now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, all 128 leads came exclusively from Meta — Google Ads spent $1,490 and returned zero conversions, which is what drove cost per lead up 68% to $22.19. Meta's implied cost per lead of roughly $10.55 shows the channel can work, but lead volume on Meta has also dropped sharply in the most recent days, so both channels need attention now. Google Ads targeting and conversion tracking are being reviewed this week to stop budget running without results. On Meta, creative is being refreshed and conversion signal improvements are in progress ahead of month-end. You should expect cleaner conversion data and stabilising lead volume as those fixes land by end of August.
